contexts.text: The man of the internal Church does this with discrimination, thus with intelligence... But the man of the external Church... does it indiscriminately.
The difference between the Divine Law and doctrine.
The difference of life between a man and a beast, [Swedenborg footnote 1.].
Under Degree, see these references. DLW 226:end. DLW 233. DLW 238. DLW 255.

There is such a difference between the affections and thoughts, and thence the speeches, of the Angels of the higher and lower Heavens, that they have nothing in common... As these differences are of such a character... they cannot be described... These differences may in some measure be comprehended by this...
The difference is, that the Angels see...

When he heard the difference between the Spiritual and the Natural, he said, What is the difference?... I answered, The difference is not such... He meditated about this difference... I said, Thou shalt not only perceive the difference between the Spiritual and the Natural, but shalt see it... In order that thou mayest know the difference between the Spiritual and the Natural as to languages...

The difference between fornication, pellicacy, etc... These said, that in interior ideas... they saw the differences... This I can assert, that these differences, as to their minute things, are perceived by the Angels of Heaven.
The difference is as that between...
As to the differences of perception...
On the difference between life in the body, and after...
In punishments and dangers he was more present...
